# [Implementation] - The CHANGES_REQUESTED verdict must reach the re-dispatched IMPLEMENT directive

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #313 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Precondition: each block is self-contained and run from the worktree root. Block 1 rebuilds
`./dist` (the gate does this first anyway) and writes two checkpoints into the sanctioned
sandbox `/tmp/opencode/agyloop-313-smoke` — never into the worktree. Every check exits non-zero
with a message on failure; `dist/` is untracked and must never be committed.

#### Check 1 — Seed a `CHANGES_REQUESTED` task and an `APPROVED`-after-`CHANGES_REQUESTED` task

```bash
npm run build
export SMOKE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/agyloop-313-smoke
rm -rf "$SMOKE_DIR"
mkdir -p "$SMOKE_DIR/artifacts/plans/999-task" "$SMOKE_DIR/artifacts/plans/998-task" "$SMOKE_DIR/.agyloop/tasks" "$SMOKE_DIR/wt-999" "$SMOKE_DIR/wt-998"
for n in 999 998; do
  cat > "$SMOKE_DIR/artifacts/plans/$n-task/implementation_plan.md" <<'PLAN'
# [Implementation] - probe

**Issue:** #999

## 3. Implementation Steps
- [ ] **Step 1:** do the probe
PLAN
done
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const dir = process.env.SMOKE_DIR;
const now = new Date().toISOString();
const base = (n) => ({
  version: "1.0.0",
  currentStage: "IMPLEMENT",
  mode: "standard",
  issue: n,
  planDir: `${dir}/artifacts/plans/${n}-task`,
  baseBranch: "main",
  worktree: { taskId: String(n), worktreePath: `${dir}/wt-${n}`, branch: `fix/${n}`, baseBranch: "main", isIsolated: true },
  createdAt: now,
  updatedAt: now
});
const changes = base(999);
changes.history = [
  { stage: "IMPLEMENT", timestamp: now },
  {
    stage: "IMPLEMENT",
    timestamp: now,
    metadata: {
      reviewVerdict: "CHANGES_REQUESTED",
      reviewRound: 2,
      reviewTokens: "REVIEW_STATUS: CHANGES_REQUESTED\nREVIEW_SUMMARY: round two summary\nUNFULFILLED_AC:\n- AC one\nREMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:\n- REMEDIATION_SENTINEL_313"
    }
  }
];
fs.writeFileSync(`${dir}/.agyloop/tasks/999.json`, JSON.stringify(changes, null, 2));
const approved = base(998);
approved.history = [
  { stage: "IMPLEMENT", timestamp: now },
  {
    stage: "IMPLEMENT",
    timestamp: now,
    metadata: {
      reviewVerdict: "CHANGES_REQUESTED",
      reviewRound: 2,
      reviewTokens: "REVIEW_STATUS: CHANGES_REQUESTED\nREVIEW_SUMMARY: round one summary\nUNFULFILLED_AC:\n- AC one\nREMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:\n- REMEDIATION_SENTINEL_313"
    }
  },
  {
    stage: "IMPLEMENT",
    timestamp: now,
    metadata: {
      reviewVerdict: "APPROVED",
      reviewRound: 3,
      reviewTokens: "REVIEW_STATUS: APPROVED\nREVIEW_SUMMARY: all good\nUNFULFILLED_AC:\n- None\nREMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:\n- None"
    }
  }
];
fs.writeFileSync(`${dir}/.agyloop/tasks/998.json`, JSON.stringify(approved, null, 2));
console.log("seeded 999 (CHANGES_REQUESTED round 2) and 998 (APPROVED round 3)");
'
```

#### Check 2 — The `CHANGES_REQUESTED` remediation reaches the IMPLEMENT prompt

```bash
export SMOKE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/agyloop-313-smoke
node bin/codeloop.js next --issue 999 --workspace "$SMOKE_DIR" --json > "$SMOKE_DIR/changes.json"
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const dir = process.env.SMOKE_DIR;
const out = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${dir}/changes.json`, "utf8"));
const prompt = out.invocationPayload.Subagents[0].Prompt;
const required = [
  "CHANGES_REQUESTED",
  "REVIEW_SUMMARY: round two summary",
  "UNFULFILLED_AC",
  "REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE",
  "- REMEDIATION_SENTINEL_313",
  "Round 2"
];
const missing = required.filter((token) => !prompt.includes(token));
if (out.role !== "implementer") {
  console.error(`S2 FAIL: expected the implementer directive, got role ${out.role}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
if (out.reviewRemediationRound !== 2) {
  console.error(`S2 FAIL: expected reviewRemediationRound 2, got ${out.reviewRemediationRound}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
if (missing.length > 0) {
  console.error(`S2 FAIL: prompt is missing ${missing.join(", ")}\n---\n${prompt}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log("S2 PASS: round 2 verdict, summary, unfulfilled AC and remediation are in the IMPLEMENT prompt");
'
```

#### Check 3 — A later `APPROVED` round carries no stale remediation

```bash
export SMOKE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/agyloop-313-smoke
node bin/codeloop.js next --issue 998 --workspace "$SMOKE_DIR" --json > "$SMOKE_DIR/approved.json"
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const dir = process.env.SMOKE_DIR;
const out = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${dir}/approved.json`, "utf8"));
const prompt = out.invocationPayload.Subagents[0].Prompt;
const leaks = ["REMEDIATION_SENTINEL_313", "Review Remediation", "REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:"]
  .filter((token) => prompt.includes(token));
if (out.role !== "implementer") {
  console.error(`S3 FAIL: expected the implementer directive, got role ${out.role}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
if ("reviewRemediationRound" in out) {
  console.error(`S3 FAIL: an APPROVED round must not report a remediation round, got ${out.reviewRemediationRound}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
if (leaks.length > 0) {
  console.error(`S3 FAIL: stale round-2 remediation leaked into the APPROVED re-dispatch: ${leaks.join(", ")}\n---\n${prompt}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log("S3 PASS: APPROVED supersedes the earlier round; no stale remediation in the directive");
'
```

#### Check 4 — The checkpoint is the source (restart / teardown durability)

```bash
export SMOKE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/agyloop-313-smoke
node bin/codeloop.js next --issue 999 --workspace "$SMOKE_DIR" --json > "$SMOKE_DIR/restart.json"
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const dir = process.env.SMOKE_DIR;
const checkpoint = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${dir}/.agyloop/tasks/999.json`, "utf8"));
if (!JSON.stringify(checkpoint.history).includes("REMEDIATION_SENTINEL_313")) {
  console.error("S4 FAIL: the checkpoint no longer records the review tokens");
  process.exit(1);
}
const prompt = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${dir}/restart.json`, "utf8")).invocationPayload.Subagents[0].Prompt;
if (!prompt.includes("REMEDIATION_SENTINEL_313")) {
  console.error("S4 FAIL: a fresh next process lost the remediation\n---\n" + prompt);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log("S4 PASS: a second, independent next invocation rebuilds the remediation from the checkpoint");
'
```

#### Check 5 — The read is still read-only

```bash
export SMOKE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/agyloop-313-smoke
cp "$SMOKE_DIR/.agyloop/tasks/999.json" "$SMOKE_DIR/999.before.json"
node bin/codeloop.js next --issue 999 --workspace "$SMOKE_DIR" --json > /dev/null
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const dir = process.env.SMOKE_DIR;
const before = fs.readFileSync(`${dir}/999.before.json`);
const after = fs.readFileSync(`${dir}/.agyloop/tasks/999.json`);
if (!before.equals(after)) {
  console.error("S5 FAIL: next mutated the checkpoint on the IMPLEMENT read path");
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log("S5 PASS: next returned the remediation without writing the checkpoint");
'
```
